title: Some poems never form hidden in fog weighing heavy on eyelids with history neither sung or seen just felt is cold vapors of misery #smallpoems
summary: Some poems never form hidden in fog weighing heavy on eyelids with history neither sung or seen just felt is cold vapors of misery #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Some poems
  never form
hidden
  in fog
weighing heavy
  on eyelids
with history
neither sung or
seen
  just felt
is cold vapors
  of misery
#smallpoems
